crossRefs.note: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any…
Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little…

translations.web: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’ ” So the people were faint.
translations.bsb: Then one of the soldiers told him, “Your father bound the troops with a solemn oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’ That is why the people are faint.”
translations.kjv: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged ➔ the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.
translations.asv: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth food this day. And the people were faint.
